about.title: About me
paragraphs: For 4 years I've been building PHP backends — mostly Laravel — on a production B2B product. At ModulesGarden I work on PanelAlpha, a platform that helps service companies automate WordPress management.

I like owning a feature from the backend layer through to working business logic — and when needed, I pick up the frontend (Vue.js). I work on a live product, so I care about code that actually works for customers.
Day to day I use AI tools (including Cursor) to support implementation and refactoring. Outside of code — family, time outdoors, and keeping up with the industry.

entries.summary: I develop the Laravel backend of a production B2B platform that automates WordPress management for service companies. I'm responsible for APIs, integrations with external infrastructure, and the logic for managing WordPress instances.
highlights: Infrastructure integrations — hosting panels (cPanel, Plesk, DirectAdmin, WP Cloud), DNS (PowerDNS, Cloudflare, Bunny), mail servers (mailcow), and SSL certificate automation (Let's Encrypt)
WordPress lifecycle — instance import and management, Git support, onboarding (Extendify, 10Web)
Backup and storage — local and remote backups (S3, FTP, SFTP, FTPS)
Billing and API — WHMCS integrations and platform API development
Full-stack — frontend (Vue.js, Vuetify) for features that span backend and UI

entries.summary: I built custom WHMCS modules for a hosting billing platform — business logic, integrations, and operational tooling (PHP, JavaScript, Smarty).
highlights: Billing automation — including Invoice Sub Status, Automated Refunds, Auto Upgrade For Early Payments For WHMCS, admin fees on product changes
Integrations — Domain data from Plesk, Docker S3 Container
Operational tooling — BulkUpdater for bulk updates in WHMCS
